decision: Conditional exact-integer reliability before another Tmax model

target.event: 1 iff audited integer Tmax equals frozen base PMF smallest-argmax integer

evidence.historical_experiment_budget: one registered six-model family; amendments append to ledger; no unseen-claim reset

weather_features.rationale: Forecast instability; not observed forecast error
Related-product disagreement; not independent ensemble spread
Remaining solar forcing and daylight; forecast proxy
Low-level thermal contrast; not asserted above-ground lapse rate

feature_exclusions: model-specific support diagnostics in this first shared comparison

estimator.objective: mean day-weighted binary NLL + 0.01/2 * sum(nonintercept coefficients squared)
estimator.season: two Fourier harmonics using frozen clock sin/cos, second harmonic algebraically derived
estimator.standardization: training-only day-weighted mean and population SD per nonintercept term; drop training constants; no assessment clipping
estimator.missing: common complete-case support across R0/R1/R2 and both base forecasts; explicit abstentions count against expected coverage
estimator.invalid_nonnegative_feature: abstain if negative before log1p; no absolute-value repair
estimator.class_weighting: none; equal total weight per target day; equal eligible issues within day
estimator.solver: scipy L-BFGS-B analytic gradient; zero start; maxiter 2000; gtol 1e-6; ftol 1e-12; require success and max absolute gradient <=1e-4; no silent fallback

chronology.freeze: reliability model fitted before threshold block; same unchanged model scores threshold and assessment; no refit after threshold calibration
chronology.base_versions: use each row historical base vintage, never final model fitted using future labels; report version drift
chronology.base_reuse: only after successor certificate recomputes lag-correct selections and verifies fit/forecast lineage; S5 sensitivity is supporting evidence, not sufficient runtime certificate
chronology.threshold_dates: feature-only thresholds need no hit labels; exclude final day anyway for common conservative boundary

selection.threshold: smallest score with training-threshold-block weighted CDF >= 1-coverage; all ties admitted; threshold fixed throughout assessment
selection.weights: original expected-issue day weights; missing predictions excluded from quantile but counted against reported coverage
selection.abstention: no output if required predictors unavailable; no fallback
selection.comparisons: R0/R1/R2 selectors may choose different cases; also score B0_H and B0_Q integer decisions on R2 identical cases; do not call same-base integer hits a R2-versus-R1 same-case advantage

inference.primary_metric: day-weighted binary Brier on all common-supported assessment checkpoints
inference.bootstrap: reuse S5 paired noncircular calendar-block implementation within assessment blocks; all checkpoints of a day together; original fold mass
inference.meaning: two Bonferroni-adjusted nominal approximate familywise 95% intervals; historical inference remains exploratory after exposure
secondary: exact hit and coverage by fold/season/issue
tail error of unchanged base forecast
inference.undefined: null; report undefined bootstrap fraction; interval unavailable if <95% finite

research_readiness.meaning: explicit engineering/research targets, not economic break-even or retrospective formal promotion
research_readiness.primary_requirement: upper adjusted R2-R1 Brier difference <= -0.002; both blocks point differences <0; assess each base separately, no best-model-only report
research_readiness.binary_nll_requirement: pooled and each block R2-R1 point difference <=0.01
research_readiness.gate_requirement: each block must meet coverage, days, gap and same-case Q point lift targets; report descriptive uncertainty and sparse bins; fail or inconclusive cannot be converted to pass by trying another cutoff
research_readiness.failure_policy: publish negative/inconclusive result; no automatic extra candidates or retuning

activate_only_if: successor runtime and scoring code sealed before deadline
live feature availability independently verified against R14 definitions
base and reliability artifact identities and training dates frozen
one evidence-aware final protocol specifies operational schedule and permitted training data
forecast archive writes before issuance/outcome; append-only hashes
exposure audit confirms no outcomes from reserved future period used in decisions
prospective_reservation.if_not_ready: do not backfill or claim prospective validation; amend reservation before outcomes are accessed, with reason and new dates
prospective_reservation.retraining: none during reserved year in initial protocol; any operational change logged and changes comparison identity
prospective_reservation.interim: operational checks only; no outcome-driven model/threshold changes or early success stopping
prospective_reservation.commercial_bridge: only after prospective scientific assessment and separate market-data/execution registration

next_implementation: CR1: forward-lineage certificate, reliability estimator, honest threshold blocks, bounded synthetic checks, forecast-only freeze then scoring; no CR1 fitting performed in S6
